title: The Hard Extraction
author: Petra Vasquez
blurb: Rosalind Reyes, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
